0.content: Bennett's registered adventure team in the Mondstadt Adventurers' Guild. Guild rules want three or four regulars per team for safety, but only Bennett remains. Jack quit after a rare Geo turbulence opened a chasm a few feet from the treasure and left him heartbroken. Royce was knocked out when Klee blew up the cave they were exploring, thinking it a giant rabbit hole (Klee got seven days in confinement). Heckler blamed a week of food poisoning on Bennett's luck. Bennett begged Katheryne not to invalidate the registration, claiming they were "on leave"; she spared him the truth. Privately he knows why they left.

1.comment: Bennett: The Dads and the Adventurers' Guild
1.content: Several single, childless old adventurers of the Mondstadt Guild raised the orphan and named him Bennett; he calls each of them "Dad". Caring for them takes up most of his time outside adventuring: fishing dentures out of soup, nagging about old leather armour and undergarments, telling them to stand away from him in thunderstorms. Guild Master Cyrus laughs that the dads found a treasure in him. Bennett wants to find the greatest treasure in the world so his dads can live better and the Guild can thrive again. Katheryne kept his team registered out of kindness.

2.comment: Bennett: The Old Adventurer and the Foundling
2.content: Bennett's Character Stories tell of an old adventurer who crossed a hellish ordeal of scalding flame, deafening thunder and soul-tearing wind, and found at its end a baby barely alive. Believing it "a child abandoned by the world itself", he took the baby as his treasure, even if it meant defying the world's will. He died of his injuries before telling the story, saying only "will", "adventure" and "final treasure". The baby was Bennett. Bennett knows his rescuer left many legends behind and has come to think a death given to adventure might even be fortunate.

3.comment: Bennett: Macani, Aroni and Tecpatl's Flintblades
3.content: Bennett's birth parents. Macani of the Collective of Plenty was a brash young captain who founded the adventure team Tecpatl's Flintblades; Aroni of the Masters of the Night-Wind, curious and fond of journals and photos, joined him, followed by Anja and Chaco. After their son was born they planned to retire after one last journey. On that journey to Tenochtzitoc they strayed into the Mare Jivari, where the Abyss attacked their camp; Aroni shielded the baby, and all four prayed to give their bodies, love and memories so that he might live, becoming memoryless Asha. In 5.8 the Asha were drawn to Bennett at the Easybreeze resort. After the Abyssal domain, they briefly regained themselves and told him how loved he was.

4.content: Bennett visits the Favonius Cathedral for fractures and blood loss, apologising every time ("Sorry, it's me again..."). Barbara shakes her head and tosses him adhesive bandages for the scratches too. He sticks them on like medals and keeps a pouch of bandages from his dads, Barbara, Katheryne and strangers, his personal collection of good fortune. Barbara was surprised how skilled he is at resetting dislocations, and wishes he took better care of himself. He also loves her concerts, cheering along after bad adventures.

5.content: Bennett admires the Traveler as the adventurer of legends and wants to be their helping hand, someone they can depend on through good times and bad. He offers to draw monsters and spring traps so the Traveler can take the treasure, and assumes they joined his team at some point. In 5.8 the Traveler shared his vacation and his reunion with his parents and called him "a lucky star" to coax him onstage. Paimon worries his luck will get them killed in domains, but cares about him.
